verdict.rationale: Bento documents a bulk create-or-update subscribers endpoint (POST /batch/subscribers, 1 to 1000 subscribers per request), says custom fields can be set through the API, and offers an events API that updates profile fields, which covers create and update with custom properties at batch scale. The pack has no documented suppression or unsubscribe endpoint; the only related item is an anonymization (data deletion) endpoint, which is a different capability. missing for 10: an API endpoint to suppress or unsubscribe contacts, documented rate limits and throughput for production scale, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, and suppress contacts with custom properties through the API at production scale

citations.quote: POST`/batch/subscribers` Import Subscribers Bulk create or update subscribers without triggering automations.
Request supports 1 to 1000 subscribers per post.
Fields can be set through multiple channels: Bento Forms... API... Flows... Imports... Manually
POST`/batch/events` Create Events Track user activity, update profile fields, and trigger automations.
